en.s: The siege of Bari took place 1068–1071, during the Middle Ages, when Norman forces, under the command of Robert Guiscard, laid siege to the city of Bari, a major stronghold of the Byzantines in Italy and the capital of the Catepanate of Italy, starting from 5 August 1068.

zh.s: 1068年至1071年，中世纪时期，罗伯特·吉斯卡尔率领诺曼军队围攻巴里城。巴里是拜占庭帝国在意大利的重要据点，也是意大利总督区首府。围城始于1068年8月5日。

en.t: Henry VI, King of Germany, is crowned Holy Roman Emperor by pope Celestine III
en.s: The Holy Roman Emperor, originally and officially the Emperor of the Romans (Latin: Imperator Romanorum; German: Kaiser der Römer) during the Middle Ages, and also known as the Roman-German Emperor since the early modern period (Latin: Imperator Germanorum; German: Römisch-deutscher Kaiser), was the ruler and head of state of the Holy Roman Empire.

zh.t: 德国国王亨利六世由教宗塞莱斯廷三世加冕为神圣罗马皇帝
zh.s: 神圣罗马皇帝在中世纪最初和正式称为“罗马人的皇帝”（拉丁语：Imperator Romanorum；德语：Kaiser der Römer），近代早期以来也称“罗马—德意志皇帝”（拉丁语：Imperator Germanorum；德语：Römisch-deutscher Kaiser），是神圣罗马帝国的统治者和国家元首。

en.s: The sack of Constantinople occurred in April 1204 and marked the culmination of the Fourth Crusade. Crusaders sacked and destroyed most of Constantinople, the capital of the Byzantine Empire. After the capture of the city, the Latin Empire (known to the Byzantines as the Frankokratia, or the Latin occupation) was established and Baldwin IX of Flanders crowned emperor in Hagia Sophia.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1204年4月，第四次十字军东征达到高潮，十字军攻陷君士坦丁堡。十字军洗劫并摧毁了这座拜占庭帝国首都的大部分地区。攻占城市后，十字军建立拉丁帝国（拜占庭人称之为“法兰克统治”或“拉丁占领”），并在圣索菲亚大教堂为佛兰德斯的鲍德温九世加冕为皇帝。

en.s: On April 15, 1277, the Sultan of Egypt Baybars marched from Syria into the Mongol-dominated Seljuk Sultanate of Rûm and attacked the Mongol occupation force in the Battle of Elbistan (Abulustayn). While the Mongol forces initially gained the upper hand, the likely superior numbers of the Egyptian Mamluk forces decided the battle. The victory limited Mongol influence in Asia Minor and led to open hostilities between the Mamluk Sultanate of Egypt and the Mongol Ilkhanate.

zh.s: 1277年4月15日，埃及苏丹拜巴尔从叙利亚进军由蒙古人控制的罗姆塞尔柱苏丹国，并在埃尔比斯坦（阿布鲁斯塔因）与蒙古驻军交战。蒙古军起初占据上风，但埃及马穆鲁克军队人数很可能更多，最终左右了战局。这场胜利限制了蒙古人在小亚细亚的影响力，并使埃及马穆鲁克苏丹国与蒙古伊儿汗国公开敌对。

en.s: The Battle of Formigny (15 April 1450) was a battle of the Hundred Years' War fought between England and France. It was a decisive victory for the French.

zh.s: 福尔米尼之战于1450年4月15日在英格兰与法国之间发生，属于百年战争。法军取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The naval Second Battle of Playa Honda (Spanish: Segunda La Batalla Naval de Playa Honda; Filipino: Ikalawang Labanan sa Playa Honda), was the first of three known minor conflicts during the Eighty Years' War between the Dutch Republic and Spain held in Playa Honda (present-day Botolan) in the Philippines. All the battles were won by the Spanish. The first battle occurred in 1610.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 普拉亚洪达第二次海战（西班牙语：Segunda La Batalla Naval de Playa Honda；菲律宾语：Ikalawang Labanan sa Playa Honda）是八十年战争期间荷兰共和国与西班牙之间已知三场小规模冲突中的第一场，地点在菲律宾普拉亚洪达（今博托兰）。三场战斗均由西班牙获胜。第一次战斗发生于1610年。

en.s: The Battle of Rain took place on 15 April 1632 near Rain in Bavaria during the Thirty Years' War. A Swedish army under Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden defeated a Catholic League force led by Johann Tserclaes, Count of Tilly, who later died of wounds received in the battle.

zh.s: 赖恩之战于1632年4月15日在巴伐利亚赖恩附近发生，属于三十年战争。瑞典国王古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫率军，击败蒂利伯爵约翰·策克拉斯指挥的天主教联盟军。蒂利后来因战斗中所受的伤势去世。

en.s: The Battle of Kilrush was a fought during the Irish Confederate Wars. It was fought on 15 April 1642 between a Royalist army under the Earl of Ormonde and Irish Confederate troops commanded by Lord Mountgarret.

zh.s: 基尔拉什战役发生于爱尔兰邦联战争期间。1642年4月15日，奥蒙德伯爵率领的保王党军队与蒙特加雷特勋爵指挥的爱尔兰邦联军交战。

en.s: The Battle of Dharmat was fought during the Mughal war of succession (1658–1659) by Aurangzeb against Jaswant Singh Rathore who was allied with the Mughal prince Dara Shikoh. The battle was fought on the open plain of Dharmat on the Summer day of 15 April 1658, in which Aurangzeb won a decisive victory due to advantage in imperial artillery and tactics.

zh.s: 达尔马特战役发生于莫卧儿王位继承战争（1658—1659年）期间，交战双方是奥朗则布与拉索尔王公贾斯万特·辛格。贾斯万特与莫卧儿王子达拉·舒科结盟。1658年4月15日，双方在达尔马特平原交战。凭借帝国炮兵和战术优势，奥朗则布取得决定性胜利。

en.t: The Pocotaligo Massacre triggers the start of the Yamasee War in colonial South Carolina
en.s: The Yamasee War (also spelled Yamassee or Yemassee) was a conflict fought in South Carolina from 1715 to 1717 between British settlers from the Province of Carolina and the Yamasee, who were supported by a number of allied Native American peoples, including the Muscogee, Cherokee, Catawba, Apalachee, Apalachicola, Yuchi, Waccamaw, Savannah River Shawnee, Congaree, Waxhaw, Pee Dee, Cape Fear, Cheraw, and others.

zh.t: 波科塔利戈袭击引发亚马西战争
zh.s: 1715年4月15日，亚马西人在今天的美国南卡罗来纳州波科塔利戈袭击前来谈判的殖民地代表团，亚马西战争由此爆发。这场持续至1717年的冲突发生在当时的卡罗来纳殖民地，交战双方为英国殖民者与亚马西人；后者得到马斯科吉、切罗基、卡托巴、阿帕拉奇、阿帕拉奇科拉、尤奇、瓦卡莫、萨凡纳河肖尼、康加里、瓦克肖、皮迪、开普菲尔和切罗等多个原住民族群的支持。

en.t: Serse, an Italian opera by George Frideric Handel, receives its premiere performance in London, England
en.s: Italian opera is both the art of opera in Italy and opera in the Italian language. Opera was born in Italy around the year 1600 and Italian opera has continued to play a dominant role in the history of the form until the present day. Many famous operas in Italian were written by foreign composers, including Handel, Gluck and Mozart.

zh.t: 乔治·弗里德里克·亨德尔的意大利歌剧《薛西斯》在英格兰伦敦首演
zh.s: 意大利歌剧既指意大利的歌剧艺术，也指以意大利语演唱的歌剧。歌剧约于1600年诞生于意大利，意大利歌剧至今在这一艺术形式的历史中持续占据主导地位。许多著名的意大利语歌剧由外国作曲家创作，包括亨德尔、格鲁克和莫扎特。

en.s: The Battle of Pfaffenhofen was fought on 15 April 1745 between France and Austria. The Austrians under Karl Josef Batthyány defeated the outnumbered French under General Ségur, ending the war in Bavaria.

zh.s: 1745年4月15日，法国与奥地利在普法芬霍芬交战。卡尔·约瑟夫·巴蒂亚尼率领的奥军击败了人数处于劣势的法国军队，后者由塞居尔将军指挥。这场战役结束了巴伐利亚战争。

en.s: The Battle of Littleferry (also known as the Skirmish at Golspie) took place near Littleferry during the Jacobite rising in 1746, just before the Battle of Culloden. Scottish forces loyal to the Anglo-Hanoverian Government defeated a Scottish Jacobite force.

zh.s: 利特尔费里战役又称戈尔斯皮小冲突，发生在1746年詹姆斯党起义期间，地点靠近利特尔费里，时间在卡洛登战役之前不久。效忠英格兰—汉诺威政府的苏格兰军队击败了苏格兰詹姆斯党军队。

en.t: Release of A Dictionary of the English Language
en.s: A Dictionary of the English Language, sometimes published as Johnson's Dictionary, was published on 15 April 1755 and written by Samuel Johnson. It is among the most influential dictionaries in the history of the English language. There was dissatisfaction with the dictionaries of the period, so in June 1746 a group of London booksellers contracted Johnson to write a dictionary for the sum of 1,500 guineas (£1,575), equivalent to about £300,000 in 2025.

zh.s: 塞缪尔·约翰逊编写的《英语语言词典》（有时以《约翰逊词典》之名出版）于1755年4月15日发行。它是英语词典史上最具影响力的词典之一。当时人们对现有词典并不满意，因此1746年6月，伦敦一群书商委托约翰逊编写词典，支付1500基尼（1575英镑），相当于2025年的约30万英镑。

en.s: The British occupation of Serampore also referred to as the English occupation of Serampore (Danish: Den engelske besættelse af Serampore) was a siege and thereafter a minor military occupation by the United Kingdom on the Danish trading post of Serampore (Frederiksnagore) in 1763.

zh.s: 英国占领塞兰波尔也称英格兰占领塞兰波尔（丹麦语：Den engelske besættelse af Serampore），是英国对丹麦贸易据点塞兰波尔（弗雷德里克斯纳戈尔）实施围城，随后进行短暂军事占领的事件，发生于1763年。

en.s: During the onset of the Northwest Indian War (1786–1795), there were numerous skirmishes around Vincennes in 1786 between American settlers and Native Americans near Vincennes, a frontier town on the Wabash River. American pioneers had been pouring into the area after the American Revolutionary War, creating tensions with the Native inhabitants of the region. On April 15, 1786, American militiamen from Vincennes, responding to an attack on a river boat, attacked Natives along the Embarras River; the Americans had three men killed in the skirmish.

zh.s: 西北印第安战争（1786—1795年）初期，1786年文森斯这座瓦巴什河边境城镇周围发生了多起美国移民与美洲原住民之间的冲突。美国独立战争后，大批美国拓荒者涌入当地，与当地原住民产生紧张关系。1786年4月15日，文森斯民兵为回应一艘河船遭袭，袭击了安巴拉斯河沿岸的原住民；三名美国人在这场冲突中丧生。

en.s: The Northwest Indian War was an armed conflict for control of the Northwest Territory between the United States and a loose confederation of Native American peoples who called themselves the United Indian Nations but are better known today as the Northwestern Confederacy. The United States Army considers the conflict to be the first of the American Indian Wars.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西北印第安战争是美国与一个松散的美洲原住民联盟之间，为争夺西北领地控制权而爆发的武装冲突。这个联盟自称联合印第安民族，如今通常称为西北邦联。美国陆军将这场冲突视为美国印第安战争中的第一场。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Second Battle of Dego was fought on 14 and 15 April 1796 during the French Revolutionary Wars between French forces and Austro-Sardinian forces. The battle was fought near Dego, a hamlet in northwestern Italy, and ended in a French victory.

zh.s: 第二次代戈之战于1796年4月14日至15日在法国大革命战争期间发生，交战双方为法国军队与奥地利—撒丁联军。战场位于意大利西北部代戈小村附近，法军最终获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Zacatecas was a military action of the Mexican War of Independence fought on 15 April 1811 at Zacatecas. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire. The Mexican insurgents were commanded by General Ignacio López Rayón and the Spanish by José Manuel de Ochoa.

zh.s: 萨卡特卡斯之战于1811年4月15日在萨卡特卡斯发生，是墨西哥独立战争中的一次军事行动。忠于西班牙王室的保王派军队，与争取脱离西班牙帝国独立的墨西哥起义军交战。起义军由伊格纳西奥·洛佩斯·拉永将军指挥，西班牙一方由何塞·曼努埃尔·德·奥乔亚指挥。

en.t: Battle of la Tablada de Tolomosa
en.s: The Battle of la Tablada de Tolomosa was fought on 15 April 1817 near the town of Tarija in today's southern Bolivia between the royalist forces under colonel Mateo Ramírez and republican local forces under Eustaquio Méndez allied with the Army of the North under Gregorio Aráoz de Lamadrid. The main caudillos directing the militias were Méndez, José María Avilés and Colonel Francisco Pérez de Uriondo, one of the Tarijan's commanders allied with General Güemes' guerrillas. The town's center was under Ramírez and well defended by royalist troops. The local Montoneros guerrillas surrounded the town and Ramírez's troops.

zh.s: 托洛莫萨台地之战于1817年4月15日在今玻利维亚南部塔里哈镇附近发生。马特奥·拉米雷斯上校指挥的保王派军队，与欧斯塔基奥·门德斯率领的当地共和派部队交战；共和派得到格雷戈里奥·阿劳斯·德·拉马德里指挥的北方军支持。民兵的主要领袖有门德斯、何塞·马里亚·阿维莱斯，以及与圭梅斯将军游击队结盟的塔里哈指挥官弗朗西斯科·佩雷斯·德·乌里翁多上校。镇中心由拉米雷斯控制，保王派守备严密，当地蒙托内罗斯游击队则包围了城镇与拉米雷斯部队。

en.t: Thomas Hopkins Gallaudet and Laurent Clerc found the American School for the Deaf (then called the Connecticut Asylum for the Education and Instruction of Deaf and Dumb Persons), the first American school for deaf students, in Hartford, Connecticut
en.s: Louis Laurent Marie Clerc (French: [lɔʁɑ̃ klɛʁ]; 26 December 1785 – 18 July 1869) was a French teacher called "The Apostle of the Deaf in America" and was regarded as the most renowned deaf person in American Deaf history. He was taught by Abbé Sicard and Deaf educator Jean Massieu, at the Institution Nationale des Sourds-Muets in Paris.

zh.t: 托马斯·霍普金斯·加劳德和劳伦特·克莱尔在康涅狄格州哈特福德创办美国聋人学校（当时称康涅狄格聋哑人教育与训练收容所），这是美国第一所聋人学校
zh.s: 路易·洛朗·玛丽·克莱尔（法语：[lɔʁɑ̃ klɛʁ]；1785年12月26日—1869年7月18日）是法国教师，被称为“美国聋人的使徒”，并被视为美国聋人历史上最著名的聋人。他曾在巴黎国立聋哑人学院师从西卡尔神父和聋人教育家让·马西厄。

en.s: The 1818 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was an election held on April 15, 1818, to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Nehemiah Rice Knight, the incumbent governor and Democratic-Republican nominee, beat Elisha Reynolds Potter, the Federalist candidate with 53.60% of the vote.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1818年4月15日举行州长选举。现任州长、民主共和党提名人尼希米·赖斯·奈特，以53.60%的得票率击败联邦党候选人伊莱沙·雷诺兹·波特。

en.s: The third siege of Missolonghi (Greek: Τρίτη Πολιορκία του Μεσολογγίου, often erroneously referred to as the second siege) was fought in the Greek War of Independence, between the Ottoman Empire and the Greek rebels, from 15 April 1825 to 10 April 1826. The Ottomans had already tried and failed to capture the city in 1822 and 1823, but returned in 1825 with a stronger force of infantry and a stronger navy supporting the infantry.

zh.t: 第三次迈索隆吉围城战
zh.s: 第三次迈索隆吉围城战发生于希腊独立战争期间，持续于1825年4月15日至1826年4月10日，交战双方为奥斯曼帝国与希腊起义军。这次围城常被误称为第二次围城。奥斯曼军队此前于1822年和1823年两度试图攻占该城，均未成功；1825年，他们带着更强大的步兵和提供支援的海军再次进攻。

en.s: The 1829 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was an uncontested election held on April 15, 1829, to elect the governor of Rhode Island. James Fenner, the incumbent governor and Jacksonian Party nominee, was the only candidate and so won with 100% of the vote.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1829年4月15日举行无人竞争的州长选举。现任州长、杰克逊派提名人詹姆斯·芬纳是唯一候选人，以100%的得票率获胜。

en.s: The 1835 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 15, 1835. Incumbent Democratic governor John Brown Francis won re-election to a third term, defeating Whig nominee Nehemiah R. Knight in a re-match of the previous year's election.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于1835年4月15日举行州长选举。现任民主党州长约翰·布朗·弗朗西斯，再次与前一年的对手、辉格党提名人尼希米·R.奈特竞争，击败对方后连任第三届。

en.s: The Battle of Tortuguero was the first naval battle of the Dominican War of Independence and was fought on April 15, 1844 at Tortuguero, Azua Province. A force of 3 Dominican schooners led by Commander Juan Bautista Cambiaso, defeated a force of 3 vessels of the Haitian Navy. Though it was a minor naval battle engagement, it determined the naval supremacy of the Dominican Republic over Haiti until the end of the war.

zh.s: 托尔图格罗海战是多米尼加独立战争的首次海战，于1844年4月15日在阿苏阿省托尔图格罗发生。胡安·包蒂斯塔·坎比亚索指挥的三艘多米尼加纵帆船，击败海地海军三艘舰船。虽然战斗规模不大，却确立了多米尼加共和国对海地的海上优势，并一直维持到战争结束。

en.s: The Bombardment of Tourane (15 April 1847) was a naval incident that took place during the short reign of the Vietnamese emperor Thiệu Trị (1841–47), which saw a considerable worsening of relations between France and Vietnam. The French frigates Gloire and Victorieuse, which had been sent to Tourane (now Da Nang) to negotiate for the release of two French Catholic missionaries, were surprise attacked by several Vietnamese vessels.

zh.s: 1847年4月15日的土伦港炮击事件是一起海上冲突，发生在越南皇帝绍治（1841—1847年）在位期间。当时法国与越南关系明显恶化。法国派出“荣耀”号和“胜利者”号护卫舰前往土伦港（今岘港），商谈释放两名法国天主教传教士一事，却遭多艘越南船只突然袭击。

en.s: Abraham Lincoln (February 12, 1809 – April 15, 1865) was the 16th president of the United States, from 1861 until his assassination in 1865. zh.s: 1861年4月15日，美国总统亚伯拉罕·林肯号召征召七万五千名民兵，以夺回堡垒、保卫华盛顿并维持联邦。林肯生于1809年、逝于1865年，1861年至遇刺身亡时担任美国第16任总统。他出身于肯塔基州一间小木屋，在边疆长大；任内领导联邦赢得内战、击败邦联，并在废除奴隶制中发挥重要作用。

en.s: The Battle at Picacho, also known as the Battle of Picacho Peak, was an engagement of the American Civil War on April 15, 1862. The action occurred around Picacho Peak, 50 miles (80 km) northwest of Tucson, Arizona.

zh.s: 皮卡乔战役又称皮卡乔峰战役，是美国内战期间的一场交战，发生于1862年4月15日。战斗发生在皮卡乔峰周边，距亚利桑那州图森西北约50英里（80公里）。

en.s: In the Chicago mayoral election of 1862, Democrat Francis Cornwall Sherman won a second non-consecutive term, defeating Republican Party nominee Charles N. Holden. Sherman had previously served as mayor two decades earlier, after winning the 1841 election. He had also been an unsuccessful candidate in the 1856 mayoral election.

zh.s: 在1862年的芝加哥市长选举中，民主党人弗朗西斯·科恩沃尔·谢尔曼击败共和党候选人查尔斯·N·霍尔登，再次当选市长。这是他非连续第二次担任市长；他此前在1841年当选，曾任市长，并在1856年竞选市长时落败。

en.s: On April 14, 1865, Abraham Lincoln, the 16th president of the United States, was shot at Ford's Theatre in Washington, D.C., and died the next day, one month into his second term and towards the conclusion of the American Civil War. Lincoln was watching the play Our American Cousin with his wife Mary Todd, Major Henry Rathbone, and Rathbone's fiancé Clara Harris when John Wilkes Booth, an actor and Confederate sympathizer, shot him in the head.

zh.t: 亚伯拉罕·林肯遇刺后次日去世，副总统安德鲁·约翰逊继任总统
zh.s: 1865年4月14日，美国第16任总统亚伯拉罕·林肯在华盛顿特区福特剧院遭枪击，次日去世。当时他开始第二个任期仅一个月，美国内战也接近尾声。林肯正与妻子玛丽·托德、亨利·拉思伯恩少校及拉思伯恩的未婚妻克拉拉·哈里斯观看戏剧《我们的美国表亲》，演员、邦联支持者约翰·威尔克斯·布斯向他头部开枪。

en.s: The Geomun Island incident or the Port Hamilton incident was the military occupation of Geomundo (formerly "Port Hamilton"), Korea, by the British Royal Navy from 15 April 1885 to 27 February 1887. Russia had intended to use the island as a coaling station. While the British government was alarmed by rumors of a secret agreement between Russia and Korea, these rumors did not reach the British Cabinet until after the decision to occupy Geomundo had been taken.

zh.s: 巨文岛事件又称汉密尔顿港事件。1885年4月15日至1887年2月27日，英国皇家海军军事占领了朝鲜的巨文岛（旧称“汉密尔顿港”）。俄罗斯原计划将该岛用作煤炭补给站。英国政府曾因俄国与朝鲜可能达成秘密协议的传闻而感到担忧，但英国政府作出占岛决定时，英国内阁还没有听到这些传闻。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Pitt was an engagement during the North-West Rebellion in which Cree forces under the leadership of Big Bear captured Fort Pitt from a detachment of the North-West Mounted Police on April 15, 1885. The event occurred during a broader period of conflict in the North-West Territories involving Cree and Métis groups and Canadian government forces in 1885.

zh.s: 在西北叛乱期间，大熊率领克里人攻占了皮特堡，击败了西北骑警的一支分队。这场战斗发生于1885年4月15日。1885年，西北地区的克里人和梅蒂人群体与加拿大政府军之间还发生了更广泛的冲突。

en.t: The General Electric Company is formed
en.s: General Electric Company (GE) was an American multinational conglomerate. It played a role in the development of electric power, electric light, home appliances, aviation, and medical imaging. GE was established in 1892 through the merger of Thomas Edison's Edison General Electric Company and the Thomson-Houston Electric Company, a consolidation conceived and orchestrated by financier J. P. Morgan.

zh.s: 通用电气公司是一家美国跨国企业集团，业务涉及电力、电灯、家用电器、航空和医学成像等领域。公司于1892年由托马斯·爱迪生的爱迪生通用电气公司与汤姆森-休斯顿电气公司合并成立，这项整合由金融家J. P. 摩根筹划并推动。

en.s: The 1893 South Australian colonial election was held between 15 April and 6 May 1893 to elect members to the 14th Parliament of South Australia. All 54 seats in the House of Assembly (the lower house, whose members were elected at the 1890 election) were up for re-election. This was the first state election contested by political parties; United Labor was formed in January 1891, which also led to the formation of the conservative National Defence League that same year.

zh.s: 1893年4月15日至5月6日，南澳大利亚举行殖民地选举，选出第14届南澳大利亚议会议员。众议院（下议院）全部54个席位都要改选；此前这些议员是在1890年选举中选出的。这是首次由政党参选的州选举。工党于1891年1月成立，也促成了同年保守派国防联盟的成立。

en.s: The 1899 FA Cup final was an association football match between Derby County and Sheffield United on Saturday, 15 April 1899 at the Crystal Palace stadium in south London. It was the final match of the 1898–99 FA Cup, the 28th edition of the world's oldest football knockout competition, and England's primary cup competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup, better known as the FA Cup.

zh.s: 1899年英格兰足总杯决赛于1899年4月15日星期六在伦敦南部的水晶宫球场举行，由德比郡对阵谢菲尔德联。这是1898—1899赛季英格兰足总杯的最后一场比赛，也是这项赛事第28届赛事。英格兰足总杯是世界上历史最悠久的淘汰制足球赛事，也是英格兰的主要杯赛。

en.s: The Siege of Catubig was a long and bloody engagement fought during the Philippine-American War, in which Filipino guerrillas launched a surprise attack against a detachment of U.S. infantry, and then forced them to abandon the town after a four-day siege. It began on April 15, 1900, and lasted four days before the survivors were rescued. The attack was very similar to the Balangiga Massacre south of Catubig a year later.

zh.s: 卡图比格围城战是美菲战争中一场持久而血腥的交战。菲律宾游击队突袭一支美国步兵分队，并在围攻四天后迫使美军放弃该镇。战斗始于1900年4月15日，持续四天后幸存者获救。这次袭击与一年后在卡图比格以南发生的巴朗伊加大屠杀十分相似。

en.s: The Battle of Agaarweyne (also known as Gumburu) was fought on 15 April 1903, in Agaarweyne between the British under Colonel Plunkett and the forces of Haji Muhammad Abdullah Hassan. Reinforced with a superiority in firearms, Muhammad was victorious and defeated the allied force. This battle sent shockwaves across the Horn of Africa.

zh.s: 阿加尔韦内战役又称贡布鲁战役，于1903年4月15日在阿加尔韦内发生。普伦基特上校率领的英军与哈吉·穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉·哈桑的部队交战。穆罕默德一方火器优势明显并取得胜利，击败了联军。这场战役震动了非洲之角。

en.s: The 1911 Copa del Rey final was the 10th final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey. The final was played at Jolaseta Stadium in Getxo on 15 April 1911. The match was won by Athletic Bilbao, who beat CD Español 3–1. The Athletic goals were scored by Martyn Veitch, Luis Belaunde, and Manuel Guernica, with Antonio Neyra reducing the deficit for Español with 20 minutes remaining.

zh.s: 1911年西班牙国王杯决赛是西班牙杯赛国王杯的第10届决赛。决赛于1911年4月15日在赫塔索的霍拉塞塔球场举行。毕尔巴鄂竞技以3比1击败西班牙人队夺冠。毕尔巴鄂竞技的进球由马丁·维奇、路易斯·贝朗德和曼努埃尔·格尔尼卡打入；比赛还剩20分钟时，安东尼奥·内拉为西班牙人队扳回一球。

en.s: RMS Titanic sank in the North Atlantic Ocean on 15 April 1912. The largest ocean liner in service at the time, Titanic was four days into her maiden voyage from Southampton, England, to New York City, United States, with over 2,200 people on board when she struck an iceberg at 23:40 (ship's time) on 14 April.

zh.s: 1912年4月15日，皇家邮轮泰坦尼克号在北大西洋沉没。当时它是世界上最大的在役远洋客轮，正从英国南安普敦首航前往美国纽约，航程已进行四天，船上有2200多人。按船上时间，4月14日23时40分，泰坦尼克号撞上冰山。

en.s: The Battle of Dilman (April 15, 1915) was a battle fought at Dilman between the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire. More than half of the Ottoman troops were Kurdish, almost all of whom deserted. The result was a Russian-Armenian victory under Tovmas Nazarbekian and Andranik Ozanian. Apart from the Armenian officers who served under Tovmas Nazarbekian's Russian Caucasus Army, the Armenians also deployed a volunteer battalion under the leadership of their commander Andranik and with the participation of Smbat Baroyan.

zh.s: 迪尔曼之战于1915年4月15日在迪尔曼发生，交战双方为俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国。奥斯曼部队中超过一半是库尔德人，几乎全部逃离部队。托夫马斯·纳扎尔别基扬与安德拉尼克·奥扎尼扬率领俄国—亚美尼亚一方获胜。除在纳扎尔别基扬的俄罗斯高加索军中服役的亚美尼亚军官外，亚美尼亚人还派出一支由安德拉尼克指挥、斯姆巴特·巴罗扬参与的志愿营。

en.s: The Battle of Celaya, 6–15 April 1915, was part of a series of military engagements in the Bajío during the Mexican Revolution between the winners, who had allied against the regime of Gen. Victoriano Huerta (February 1913-July 1914) and then fought each other for control of Mexico. The Constitutionalists under Gen. Venustiano Carranza faced off against the Army of the División del Norte of Pancho Villa.

zh.s: 塞拉亚战役发生于1915年4月6日至15日，是墨西哥革命期间巴希奥地区一系列军事交战的一部分。曾联合起来反对维多利亚诺·韦尔塔将军政权（1913年2月至1914年7月）的一方，随后为争夺墨西哥控制权而彼此交战。此役中，韦努斯蒂亚诺·卡兰萨将军领导的立宪军与潘乔·比利亚的北方师交锋。

en.s: The Trebizond Campaign, also known as the Battle of Trebizond, was a series of successful Russian naval and land operations that resulted in the capture of Trabzon. It was the logical step after the Erzerum Campaign. Operations began on February 5 and concluded when the Ottoman troops abandoned Trabzon on the night of April 15, 1916.

en.s: The German attack on Lagnicourt (German: Unternehmen Sturmbock [Operation Battering Ram]) on 15 April 1917 was a military operation on the Western Front during the First World War. Four German divisions conducted a spoiling attack on the positions of the 1st Anzac Corps of the British Fifth Army. The attack was intended to delay the advance of the Fifth Army towards the Hindenburg Line, inflict casualties and destroy as much equipment, particularly artillery, as possible.

zh.s: 1917年4月15日，德军在第一次世界大战西线进攻拉尼库尔，行动代号为“攻城锤”。四个德国师对英国第五集团军下属澳新第一军的阵地发动破坏性袭击，旨在延缓第五集团军向兴登堡防线推进，杀伤人员，并尽可能摧毁装备，尤其是火炮。

zh.s: 1919年4月15日，意大利法西斯分子袭击社会主义报纸《前进报》的办公室。第一次世界大战后的意大利王国社会动荡、政治冲突不断，贝尼托·墨索里尼领导的极右翼法西斯主义兴起，反对左翼尤其是激进左翼，也打击其他反法西斯力量；报社遇袭是此后多年法西斯与反法西斯暴力冲突的早期事件。

en.s: The 1922 Scottish Cup Final was played on 15 April 1922 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 44th staging of the Scottish Cup. Morton (as the Greenock club was named at the time) and Rangers contested the match, Morton won the match 1–0 with Jimmy Gourlay scoring the only goal of the game in the 12th minute.

zh.s: 第44届苏格兰杯决赛于1922年4月15日在格拉斯哥汉普登公园球场举行，由莫顿队对阵流浪者队。莫顿是这家格里诺克俱乐部当时使用的名称。吉米·古尔利在第12分钟攻入全场唯一进球，帮助莫顿以1比0获胜。

en.s: The Nihon Shōgakkō fire, or Japanese mission school fire, was a racially motivated arson that killed ten children in Sacramento, California, on April 15, 1923, at the dormitory of a Buddhist boarding school for students of Japanese ancestry. Fortunato Valencia Padilla, a Mexican-American itinerant from the Rio Grande Valley, admitted to committing the arson after his arrest in July 1923.

zh.t: 日本小学寄宿舍纵火案
zh.s: 1923年4月15日，美国加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托一所面向日裔学生的佛教寄宿学校宿舍遭纵火，10名儿童死亡。这起被称为“日本小学火灾”或“日本教会学校火灾”的事件出于种族仇恨。来自里奥格兰德河谷的墨西哥裔美国流动人员福尔图纳托·巴伦西亚·帕迪利亚，于1923年7月被捕后承认纵火。

en.s: The 1926 Eden by-election was a by-election for the Eden electorate during the 22nd New Zealand Parliament. The seat became vacant after the appointment of the sitting member, James Parr of the Reform Party as High Commissioner to London. Parr resigned on 26 March. Labour won the by-election and became the official opposition in Parliament.

zh.s: 新西兰第22届议会期间，伊甸选区举行补选。改革党现任议员詹姆斯·帕尔被任命为驻伦敦高级专员后，该席位出现空缺。帕尔于3月26日辞职。工党赢得补选，并成为议会官方反对党。

en.s: The Shanghai massacre of 12 April 1927, the April 12 Purge or the April 12 Incident as it is commonly known in China, was the violent suppression of Chinese Communist Party (CCP) organizations and leftist elements in Shanghai by forces supporting General Chiang Kai-shek and conservative factions in the Kuomintang (Chinese Nationalist Party or KMT). en.s: The Battle of Lake Kastoria (Greek: Μάχη λίμνης Καστοριάς) consisted of two parallel engagements north and south of Lake Kastoria (individually known in Greek as the battles of Argos Orestiko and of Foteini Pass) between Greek and German forces on 15 April 1941. Following the Greek failure to hold the Pass of Kleisoura on 14 April a new attempt was made to stop the German advance east of the road Bilisht (in Albania) – Kastoria – Grevena, which was used as the main route for the withdrawal of the Greek Western Macedonia Army Section.

zh.s: 卡斯托里亚湖之战指1941年4月15日希腊与德国军队在该湖南北两侧同时进行的两场战斗，希腊语中分别称为阿尔戈斯奥雷斯蒂科之战与福泰尼山口之战。希军于4月14日未能守住克利苏拉山口后，再次试图阻止德军从比利什特（位于阿尔巴尼亚）—卡斯托里亚—格雷韦纳公路以东推进。这条公路是希腊西马其顿军区部队撤退的主要路线。

en.t: World War II: In the Belfast Blitz, 200 bombers of the German Luftwaffe attack Belfast, killing some 1,000 people
en.s: The Belfast Blitz consisted of four German air raids on strategic targets in the city of Belfast in Northern Ireland, in April and May 1941 during World War II, causing high casualties. The first was on the night of 7–8 April 1941, a small attack which probably took place only to test Belfast's defences.

zh.t: 德国空军大规模轰炸贝尔法斯特
zh.s: 1941年4月15日，德国空军出动约200架轰炸机袭击英国北爱尔兰贝尔法斯特，造成大量平民伤亡。这是二战期间针对该市战略目标的四次空袭之一，空袭横跨4月和5月；首次袭击发生在4月7日至8日夜间，规模较小，可能只是试探贝尔法斯特的防空能力。

en.t: 1944 Football League War Cup South final
en.s: The 1944 Football League War Cup South Final was the final of the southern section of Football League War Cup, an unofficial cup competition held in England during the Second World War as a replacement for the suspended FA Cup. en.t: First flight of the Boeing B-52 Stratofortress
en.s: The Boeing B-52 Stratofortress is an American nuclear-capable subsonic jet-powered strategic bomber. The B-52 was designed and built by Boeing, which has continued to provide support and upgrades. It has been operated by the United States Air Force (USAF) since 1955 and was flown by NASA from 1959 to 2007. The bomber can carry up to 70,000 pounds (32,000 kg) of weapons and has a typical combat range of around 8,800 miles (7,600 nmi; 14,200 km) without aerial refueling.

zh.t: 波音B-52“同温层堡垒”首次飞行
zh.s: 波音B-52“同温层堡垒”是一款可携带核武器的亚音速战略喷气式轰炸机。该机由波音设计制造，波音至今仍为其提供支持和升级服务。美国空军自1955年起使用B-52，NASA于1959至2007年间也曾使用。该轰炸机最多可携带70,000磅（32,000千克）武器，典型作战航程约为8,800英里（7,600海里；14,200公里），无需空中加油。

en.s: Operation Shufly was a United States Marine Corps operation to improve the mobility of Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) forces in the early phases of the Vietnam War from 1962 to 1965. Beginning on 15 April 1962, Marine helicopter squadrons, associated maintenance units and air traffic control detachments deployed to Sóc Trăng Airfield in the Mekong Delta and later to Da Nang Air Base rotating every four months in order to provide assault support and CASEVAC assistance during combat operations.

en.s: The 1974 Nigerien coup d'état was a largely bloodless military insurrection which overthrew the first postcolonial government of Niger. The government that followed, while plagued by coup attempts of its own, survived until 1991. On 15 April 1974, Lieutenant-Colonel Seyni Kountché led a military coup that ended the fourteen-year rule of Niger's first President, Hamani Diori. Diori was imprisoned until 1980 and remained under house arrest. The military coup began at 1 AM on the morning of 15 April, with all but a handful of units quickly declaring for the coup leaders.

en.s: The 1986 United States bombing of Libya, code-named Operation El Dorado Canyon, comprised air strikes by the United States against Libya on Tuesday, 15 April 1986. en.s: The Hillsborough disaster was a human crush at Hillsborough football stadium in Sheffield, England, UK, on 15 April 1989, during the 1988–89 FA Cup semi-final game between Liverpool and Nottingham Forest. With 96 fatalities and 766 injured it is the worst disaster in British sporting history, and remains one of the worst recorded football disasters worldwide. The crush occurred in the two standing only central pens in the Leppings Lane stand, allocated to Liverpool supporters. In the minutes before the match's kick-off, the central pens were already being disproportionately filled with supporters, while pens on either side were much more empty.

en.s: The Marrakesh Agreement, manifested by the Marrakesh Declaration, was an agreement signed in Marrakesh, Morocco, by 124 nations on 15 April 1994, marking the culmination of the 12-year-long Uruguay Round and establishing the World Trade Organization, which officially came into being on January 1, 1995. The agreement developed out of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), supplemented by a number of other agreements on issues including trade in services, sanitary and phytosanitary measures, trade-related aspects of intellectual property and technical barriers to trade. It also established a new, more efficient and legally binding means of dispute resolution.

zh.s: 1994年4月15日，124个国家在摩洛哥马拉喀什签署《马拉喀什协定》，并发表《马拉喀什宣言》，标志着历时12年的乌拉圭回合谈判结束，同时建立世界贸易组织。世贸组织于1995年1月1日正式成立。协定以《关税与贸易总协定》为基础，并辅以服务贸易、卫生与植物卫生措施、与贸易有关的知识产权及技术性贸易壁垒等多项协议，还建立了一套更高效、具有法律约束力的争端解决机制。

en.t: At a GATT ministerial meeting in Marrakesh, Morocco, representatives of 123 countries and the European Communities signed an agreement to establish the World Trade Organization

Established on 1 January 1995, pursuant to the 1994 Marrakesh Agreement, it succeeded the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), which was created in 1948. As the world's largest international economic organization, the WTO has 166 members, representing over 98% of global trade and global GDP.

en.s: The 2025 Irvine special election was held on April 15, 2025, to fill a vacancy on the Irvine City Council created when Councilmember Larry Agran was elected Mayor of Irvine in the November 2024 election and sworn in the following December. Although Agran was elected at-large in 2022, the passage of Measure D in March 2024 restructured Irvine's electoral system.

zh.s: 2025年4月15日，尔湾举行特别选举，以填补市议会的一个空缺。此前，市议员拉里·阿格兰在2024年11月的选举中当选市长，并于同年12月宣誓就职。阿格兰虽于2022年通过全市选举当选，但2024年3月通过的D号提案重组了尔湾的选举制度。

en.s: On 15 April 2026, a school shooting occurred at the Ayser Çalık Secondary School in the Onikişubat district of Kahramanmaraş Province, Turkey. İsa Aras Mersinli, a 13-year-old student enrolled at the school, shot and killed 12 people and injured 13 more. Mersinli died from hypovolemic shock after sustaining a fatal knife injury while attempting to flee the scene.

zh.t: 2026年奥尼基沙巴特校园枪击案
zh.s: 2026年4月15日，土耳其卡赫拉曼马拉什省奥尼基沙巴特区的艾瑟尔·恰勒克中学发生校园枪击案。该校13岁学生伊萨·阿拉斯·梅尔辛利开枪打死12人、打伤13人。他在试图逃离现场时遭遇致命刀伤，因失血性休克死亡。
